items.headline: Komyshuvakha hamle me marne wale 40 hue
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne kaha sahayata kendra par hamle me 40 log mare gaye, 33 se badhkar, aur 30 se zyada abhi malbe ke neeche ho sakte hain.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur nagrik suraksha: International exams ke liye — sahayata kendra par hamla.

items.headline: Texas: Talarico 1988 ke baad pehle Democrat Senator
items.detail: Democrat James Talarico ne Republican Ken Paxton ko harakar Texas se 1988 ke baad pehli baar Senate seat jeeti; ve sabse yuva Senator bane.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: North Korea ne samundar ki taraf missile chhode
items.detail: South Korea ki sena ne kaha Sondok se kai missile chhode gaye, Binance hack ke aarop par America se baatchit se inkaar ke kuch ghante baad.
items.exam_angle: Korea prayadweep aur kootneeti: International exams ke liye — missile parikshan aur America se tanaav.

items.headline: Georgia: Bottoms pehli Black mahila governor bani
items.detail: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms ne Republican Rick Jackson ko harakar Georgia ki pehli Black mahila governor banne ka itihas racha.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — governor chunav aur aitihasik jeet.

items.headline: Michigan: El-Sayed pehle Muslim Senator bane
items.detail: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed ne Republican Mike Rogers ko harakar Michigan se Senate seat jeeti; ve America ke pehle Muslim Senator banenge.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate chunav aur aitihasik pehchan.

items.headline: Muji: 10.9 lakh card number leak ho sakte
items.detail: Japan ki Muji operator Ryohin Keikaku ne kaha lagbhag 1.09 million MUJI Card record, jinme card number shamil hain, leak ho sakte hain; lagbhag 345,000 card abhi valid hain.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha aur data sanrakshan: International exams ke liye — Japan me bada data leak.

items.headline: Ukraine-Russia-America: Abu Dhabi me 10-11 Nov baatchit
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne Witkoff aur Kushner se 90 minute baat ki; team-level trilateral baatchit Abu Dhabi me 10-11 November ko hogi, suraksha guarantee aur hawai raksha par charcha hui.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh: shanti vaarta aur suraksha guarantee — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bangladesh: December se garment mazdooron ka naya vetan
items.detail: Naye wage board ne December se sanshodhit vetan dhancha lagu karne par sahamati di; pehli badhi hui salary January me milegi, lekin vetan ka aakar abhi tay nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh: vastr udyog aur shramik vetan — padosi desh ki arthvyavastha ke liye.

items.headline: Thailand ke mantri 12 Nov ko Myanmar jayenge
items.detail: Videsh mantri Sihasak Phuangketkeow 12 November ko Myanmar jayenge; seema par jhadap aur ASEAN shikhar sammelan se pehle Myanmar ka rukh janenge.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN: Myanmar sankat aur seema suraksha — dakshin-poorv Asia ke liye.

items.headline: Myanmar Rohingya case: ICJ faisla 19 Nov ko
items.detail: ICJ ne kaha Gambia ke case me Myanmar ke khilaf antim faisla 19 November ko The Hague me sunaya jayega; Myanmar ne aaropon se inkaar kiya hai.
items.exam_angle: ICJ aur antarrashtriya kanoon: International exams ke liye — Rohingya case aur Genocide Convention.

items.headline: Congo se Ebola patient UK bheja jayega
items.detail: Congo me Ebola positive paye gaye British healthcare worker ko specialist ilaaj ke liye UK bheja ja raha hai; sarkar ne kaha janata ko khatra kam hai.
items.exam_angle: Ebola aur global health suraksha: International exams ke liye — sankramak rog aur medical evacuation.

items.headline: Hong Kong: Joshua Wong ko 10 saal aur
items.detail: Hong Kong High Court ne Joshua Wong ko videshi taaqaton se milne ke aarop me 10 saal ki saza sunayi; ve January me riha hone wale the.
items.exam_angle: Hong Kong aur rashtriya suraksha kanoon: International exams ke liye — loktantra andolan aur videshi pratibandh aarop.

items.headline: South Korea: Hormuz ke paas mission badhega
items.detail: South Korea ne Cheonghae unit ka mission Gulf of Aden se Oman ke dakshin tak badhane ka faisla kiya; P-8A vimaan aur mine-clearing team bhi jodegi, sansad ki manzoori baaki hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait aur samudri suraksha: International exams ke liye — tel marg aur antarrashtriya nauvahan.

items.headline: California: Arabpati tax haar ki taraf
items.detail: California me Proposition 40, jo lagbhag 200 arabpatiyon par ek baar 5% tax lagata, lagbhag 60% vote ginne par 55.6% 'No' ke saath haar ki taraf hai; natija abhi aadhikarik roop se ghoshit nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — ballot proposal aur wealth tax.

items.headline: America ne Iran tel network par pratibandh lagaya
items.detail: America ke Treasury ne 4 November ko Chandigarh ke Suniel Kumar Sharma aur Jaspreet Preeti Shahid par pratibandh lagaya, jinka aarop hai ki unhone Iranian tel le jaane wale jahazon ko nakli jhanda aur certificate diye; Turkiye ki ek company par bhi pratibandh laga.
items.exam_angle: Pratibandh aur shadow fleet: International exams ke liye — Iran tel pratibandh aur samudri dhokhadhadi.

items.headline: Democrat ne Congress ke dono sadan jeete
items.detail: Democrat ne House me 235 seat jeetkar aur Senate me saat seat palatkar Congress ke dono sadan par kabza kar liya; Trump ko ab vibhajit sarkar me kaam karna hoga.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — midterm chunav aur vibhajit sarkar.

items.headline: Trump: Iran yuddh ne haraya, phir bhi karunga
items.detail: Trump ne mana Iran yuddh ne petrol mehenga karke Republican ko midterm me haraya, lekin kaha Iran ko parmanu hathiyar se rokna zaroori tha aur woh phir bhi wahi karte.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran sambandh: International exams ke liye — yuddh aur chunav par asar.

items.headline: Bavaria neta Aiwanger Berlin hotel me mrit mile
items.detail: Bavaria ke up-pradhan aur arth mantri Hubert Aiwanger, 55, Berlin ke hotel kamre me mrit mile; police ne jaanch shuru ki, maut ka karan abhi saaf nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Germany ki rajneeti: International exams ke liye — rajya sarkar aur neta.

items.headline: Armenia: Vipaksh ne ekjut hone ka elaan kiya
items.detail: Armenia ke vipakshi dalon ne 'rashtriya ekjutata' banane ka elaan kiya; naya samvidhan kharij karna aur bina ektarfa samjhote ke shanti unki prathamikta hai.
items.exam_angle: Armenia aur Dakshin Caucasus: International exams ke liye — samvidhan, shanti aur vipaksh.

items.headline: Japan: Docomo network desh bhar thapp
items.detail: NTT Docomo ne kaha subah 11:18 baje se pure Japan me call, data aur SMS mushkil ho gaye; isse pehle online shop aur My docomo bhi band kiye gaye kyunki server me ghuspaith ka shak hai.
items.exam_angle: Japan ki telecom suraksha: International exams ke liye — cyber hamla aur aavashyak seva par asar.

items.headline: Japan: Shodo ko UNESCO virasat ki sifarish
items.detail: UNESCO ki salahkar sanstha ne Japan ki shodo kala ko Amurt Sanskritik Virasat suchi me shamil karne ki sifarish ki; antim faisla December me hoga.
items.exam_angle: UNESCO Amurt Sanskritik Virasat: International exams ke liye — Japan ki 24th entry ho sakti hai.
